explanation: The Iliad never mentions the heel. The story of his mother dipping him in the River Styx, holding him by one heel, first appears in Roman-era poetry.

claims.text: In later Greek and Roman legend, Achilles could be wounded only at his heel.
Hector, Odysseus and Heracles are not the hero with the vulnerable heel.
Homer's Iliad does not mention Achilles' heel or any invulnerability.
The story of Thetis dipping the infant Achilles in the River Styx while holding him by the heel first appears in Roman-era poetry, such as Statius's Achilleid.
